intro: Harissa is a vibrant North African chili paste featured on the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads). This fiery condiment combines premium chili peppers, garlic, olive oil, and aromatic spices to create a bold flavor enhancer. At 70 calories, Harissa adds authentic Mediterranean heat to any bowl or pita. Explore the [full CAVA menu](//) to discover how this zesty spread transforms your meal.
priceCalories: Harissa is included with your CAVA order when selecting up to 3 dips and spreads at no additional charge. Each serving contains 70 calories, making it a flavorful yet reasonable addition. With 6g of fat, 5g of carbs, and 1g of protein, this North African chili paste delivers bold taste without excessive calories. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) for personalized meal planning.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets Harissa apart is its authentic North African recipe blending smoky chili peppers with garlic and premium olive oil. Unlike generic hot sauces, this traditional paste offers complex layers of heat and flavor. The carefully balanced spice blend provides warmth without overwhelming other ingredients. Harissa brings restaurant-quality Mediterranean flavor to your customized [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) creations.
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Harissa provides 70 calories with a balanced macronutrient profile of 6g fat, 5g carbohydrates, and 1g protein. The olive oil base contributes heart-healthy fats while keeping the calorie count moderate. This dip offers bold flavor intensity without excessive sodium or artificial additives. Compare nutrition across the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) to build your ideal meal.
whatsInside: Harissa features authentic North African chili peppers as its foundation, blended with fresh garlic and premium olive oil. Traditional spices including cumin, coriander, and caraway create its signature complex flavor profile. The paste contains no artificial preservatives, focusing on natural ingredients for genuine Mediterranean taste. This simple yet powerful combination delivers restaurant-quality flavor in every 70-calorie serving.
tasteLike: Harissa delivers a bold, smoky heat with layers of garlic and warm spices. The initial taste brings peppery intensity followed by earthy cumin and aromatic notes. Unlike one-dimensional hot sauces, this paste offers complex flavor that enhances rather than masks other ingredients. The olive oil base creates a smooth, rich texture that coats your palate with lingering warmth and depth.
customize: Pair Harissa with cooling [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) options like RightRice or SuperGreens to balance its heat. Combine it with Tzatziki or Hummus for a flavor contrast that highlights both spreads. Add it to grilled proteins from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) for extra dimension. Use sparingly at first to gauge your heat preference, then adjust to taste.
pairsWell: Harissa pairs exceptionally well with Tzatziki, creating a perfect hot-and-cool flavor balance in your bowl. It complements grilled chicken and spicy lamb meatballs by enhancing their savory notes. The chili paste also brightens roasted vegetables and adds depth to falafel. Combine with Hummus or Roasted Eggplant Dip for a multi-layered Mediterranean spread experience that elevates any [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas) selection.
healthyChoice: At 70 calories per serving, Harissa delivers maximum flavor impact with minimal caloric cost. The olive oil provides monounsaturated fats supporting heart health and nutrient absorption. Natural chili peppers contain capsaicin, which may boost metabolism and provide anti-inflammatory benefits. With only 5g carbs and no added sugars, this spread fits various dietary approaches while adding authentic Mediterranean nutrition.
howToOrder: Select Harissa when building your custom bowl or pita at the dips and spreads station. It counts as one of your three included spreads at no extra charge. Request it on the side if you prefer controlling the heat level. Order through the CAVA app or in-store, specifying Harissa alongside your choices from bases, proteins, and toppings for a personalized Mediterranean experience.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Hummus at 50 calories, Harissa offers 70 calories but delivers significantly more heat and complexity. Red Pepper Hummus provides 40 calories with mild sweetness, while Harissa brings bold, spicy intensity. Tzatziki at 30 calories offers cooling contrast, making it an ideal complement rather than alternative. Roasted Eggplant Dip provides smoky flavor at 50 calories, but lacks Harissa's characteristic heat and North African spice profile.
whoShouldTry: Spice enthusiasts seeking authentic North African flavors will appreciate Harissa's complex heat profile. Those following Mediterranean diets benefit from its traditional ingredients and healthy olive oil base. Adventure-seeking diners wanting to elevate standard bowls should experiment with this bold spread. Anyone looking to add restaurant-quality flavor without significant calories will find Harissa an ideal choice for customization.
worthTrying: Harissa absolutely deserves a spot in your CAVA rotation for its authentic Mediterranean flavor and versatility. At 70 calories with no additional cost, it offers exceptional value for bold taste seekers. The complex spice blend elevates ordinary ingredients into extraordinary meals. Whether you love heat or want to gradually build spice tolerance, Harissa provides an approachable yet exciting way to explore North African cuisine.

faqs.a: CAVA Harissa delivers moderate heat with complex flavor rather than overwhelming spiciness. The North African chili paste provides warmth balanced by garlic and aromatic spices. Most diners find it pleasantly spicy without being painfully hot, making it accessible for those building heat tolerance while satisfying spice enthusiasts.

faqs.q: Is Harissa included free at CAVA?
faqs.a: Yes, Harissa is included free when you select up to 3 dips and spreads with your bowl or pita. There is no additional charge for this premium North African chili paste. It counts as one of your three complimentary spread selections alongside options like Hummus and Tzatziki.

faqs.q: What are the ingredients in CAVA Harissa?
faqs.a: CAVA Harissa contains North African chili peppers, garlic, premium olive oil, and traditional spices including cumin, coriander, and caraway. The recipe focuses on authentic ingredients without artificial preservatives. This simple combination creates the signature smoky, spicy flavor profile characteristic of traditional North African cuisine.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Harissa?
faqs.a: CAVA Harissa contains 70 calories per serving with 6g of fat, 5g of carbohydrates, and 1g of protein. The calorie content comes primarily from heart-healthy olive oil used in the traditional recipe. This makes it a moderate-calorie option that delivers bold flavor without excessive nutritional impact on your meal.

faqs.q: What does CAVA Harissa taste like?
faqs.a: CAVA Harissa tastes smoky and spicy with layers of garlic and warm spices like cumin and coriander. The North African chili paste offers complex heat rather than one-dimensional burn. The olive oil base creates smooth richness while aromatic spices provide earthy depth, making it more sophisticated than typical hot sauces.
